lineage.description: IDP displacement data consolidated from multiple monitoring hubs (OCHA regional offices, CCCM cluster, and NPM) that track population movements between Syrian governorates. Monthly arrival estimations and cumulative flow summaries from January 2016 to July 2017 were aggregated using each hub's defined methodology to produce origin-destination matrices.
